overview: Three arrows that carry something to where they land: a torch arrow that plants a torch on whatever it strikes, a fire arrow that sets things alight and lights TNT, and an explosive arrow with a block of TNT on the tip.
They are ammunition like any other arrow, so a bow, a crossbow and a dispenser all fire them.

1.0.1: A fresh build. The arrows themselves are unchanged.
1.0.0: Three arrows: a torch set on the face it strikes.
Fire that lights what it hits and sets off sitting TNT.
A blast big enough to open a wall and small enough to shoot from where you stand.
A crafting table makes all three, and a fletching table does too when Fletch Craft is installed.
